manuscript.Abstract: Among 120 patients, the exercise intervention lowered the primary symptom score compared with controls (p<0.05).
manuscript.Methods: We randomised 96 patients to the exercise intervention or to usual care. Allocation details were not described. The primary symptom score was compared between arms with a t test.
manuscript.Results: The exercise intervention significantly improved the primary symptom score (p<0.05).
manuscript.Conclusion: Structured exercise lowers symptom scores in patients with chronic fatigue.
